description.p: Flowlin is a fast local image browser for Linux. Pick a folder in the tree, see its images as thumbnails, and step through them full size with the arrow keys. Recursive mode shows every image below a folder in one grid.

ul.li: Full-size viewer with zoom, pan, slideshow and animated images
Folder jumps with W/A/S/D keys and right-button mouse gestures
Tabs, favourites, file management with undo
Private by design: no network access, no thumbnail files on disk, nothing remembered about what you opened

description.p: First release: browser, viewer, recursive mode.
